THE BIGGER PICTURE

A real model.
A transparent result.

A logistic regression classifier combines clinical inputs to predict the coronary disease class represented in a historical dataset. See exactly how it was trained and tested.

Experimental, not clinically validated. This model can be wrong. Its output cannot diagnose or exclude disease and is not a future-risk estimate. Do not use it to change treatment or delay care.

KNOWLEDGE IS A FORM OF CARE

Get to know your heart.

Simple, trusted information for a more informed next step.

01 / UNDERSTAND

Know your risk factors

High blood pressure, high cholesterol, smoking, and diabetes can affect heart health. Family history also matters.

Read the CDC guide ↗
02 / RECOGNIZE

Know when to get help

Chest discomfort, shortness of breath, or pain in the jaw, back, or arm can be heart attack warning signs. Seek emergency help for possible symptoms.

Learn the warning signs ↗
03 / TALK ABOUT IT

Make your visit count

Bring your blood pressure and cholesterol readings, medication list, family history, and any symptoms to your next appointment.

Educational information adapted from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Pulse’s separate machine-learning model is experimental and has not been clinically validated.
